records: T54's XRPL AI Hub dashboard is operator-controlled. Its 14,736,175 payment count and USD42,048.63 value are not independently audited in this pass; displayed live settlement rows are labelled 'Unverified' despite a 'verified before settle' banner. Asset mix and validated transaction IDs were not supplied with the aggregate.

T54 dashboard units differ: 183 registered merchants, 45 merchants with live services, 131 providers, 5,258 endpoints, 40 named live merchants and five unnamed live-service addresses. Endpoint count is not independent merchant count. Batch settlement can aggregate many service payments into one ledger transaction.

Mastercard AP4M participation, t54 seed investment, Evernorth integration intent and Arco/Hecto MOUs do not prove live XRP settlement or production volume. Evernorth's 473M XRP holding is a treasury stock; deployed amount and counterparty flows are undisclosed.
